title: MultiblockCore: First Steps
summary: Set up the first safe MultiblockCore loop before widening the route.

blocks.title: Start Small
blocks.body: Place one blueprint, gather its exact block family, and finish the base structure before worrying about upgrades or automation.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: Your first structure should be one blueprint on flat, readable ground with all required blocks staged nearby before upgrades enter the conversation.

blocks.title: Before You Expand
blocks.body: Name the goal, the exit, and the resource or signal that proves MultiblockCore is helping. If any of those are vague, keep the next run shorter.

blocks.title: Ready Check
blocks.body: Before moving on, confirm the first setup step is repeatable and safe enough to do again.
